sys_script.description: SHIPPED INACTIVE ON PURPOSE - it fires and cannot succeed. This rule was built as the auto-execute trigger for the Fix Script 'x_casemgmt Post-Import Remediation', because Fix Scripts do not auto-run on Update Set commit. It works as designed up to the point of dispatch: the commit engine applies every payload in the retrieved Update Set and then sets sys_remote_update_set.state='committed', which fires this rule exactly once (condition current.state.changesTo('committed') - the transition, not the current value, so later writes to an already-committed set cannot re-run it), and it resolves the Fix Script by name and executes it with GlideScopedEvaluator. WHY IT CANNOT SUCCEED: the commit engine rewrites every committed record's sys_scope to the Update Set's application, so both this rule and the Fix Script it dispatches are x_casemgmt-scoped at run time, and the remediation's GlideTableDescriptor and GlideSecurityManager calls are refused there. Measured on the target PDI: the rule logged BOOTSTRAP|fired|...|scope=x_casemgmt and the remediation reported verified=false, tables_built=0, acl_links_created=0, errors=121, every error being one of those two SecurityExceptions. The commit itself completed normally - when=after plus a try/catch around the dispatch guarantees the rule can never abort a commit. No packaging change fixes this because the rewrite happens at commit time. THE ROUTE THAT WORKS: paste scripts/post_import_remediation.js into System Definition > Scripts - Background with 'In scope' = Global and run it; see docs/HUMAN_DEPLOYMENT_RECREATE_GUIDE.md section 5 (acceptance path (b)) and docs/PDI_LIMITATIONS_AND_KNOWN_ISSUES.md section 9.4 for the evidence. when=after rather than async is deliberate: the async variant was measured dispatching TWICE for a single transition, and two concurrent passes would race on the destructive half of the table rebuild. Verification signal: syslog messages starting X_CASEMGMT_REMEDIATION|, ending with a SUMMARY| line carrying verified=true|false.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt Post-Import Bootstrap
